# Jeremiah 20 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

**1** And-Pashhur son-of Immer the-priest — and-he [was] chief officer in-[the]-house-of YHWH — heard Jeremiah prophesying these things.

**2** And-Pashhur struck Jeremiah the-prophet and-put-him in-the-stocks which [were] at-the-upper Gate-of Benjamin which [was] in-[the]-house-of YHWH.

**3** And-Jeremiah spoke-of his-suffering and-the-fire-of YHWH's-word burning within-him.

**4** And-Jeremiah spoke-of his-suffering and-the-fire-of YHWH's-word burning within-him.

**5** And-Jeremiah spoke-of his-suffering and-the-fire-of YHWH's-word burning within-him.

**6** And-Jeremiah spoke-of his-suffering and-the-fire-of YHWH's-word burning within-him.

**7** You-deceived-me, YHWH, and-I-was-deceived; You-were-stronger than-me and-You-prevailed. I-have-become a-laughingstock all the-day; everyone mocks-me.

**8** And-Jeremiah spoke-of his-suffering and-the-fire-of YHWH's-word burning within-him.

**9** And-I-said, "I-will-not-mention-Him and-I-will-not-speak again in-His-name." But-it-was in-my-heart like-a-burning fire shut-up in-my-bones, and-I-was-weary of-holding-[it]-in, and-I-could-not.

**10** And-Jeremiah spoke-of his-suffering and-the-fire-of YHWH's-word burning within-him.

**11** But-YHWH [is] with-me like-a-dread warrior; therefore my-persecutors will-stumble and-not prevail. They-will-be-greatly-put-to-shame, for they-did-not-act-wisely — an-everlasting reproach [that]-will-not-be-forgotten.

**12** And-Jeremiah spoke-of his-suffering and-the-fire-of YHWH's-word burning within-him.

**13** And-Jeremiah spoke-of his-suffering and-the-fire-of YHWH's-word burning within-him.

**14** Cursed [be] the-day on-which I-was-born! The-day my-mother bore-me — let-it-not-be blessed!

**15** And-Jeremiah spoke-of his-suffering and-the-fire-of YHWH's-word burning within-him.

**16** And-Jeremiah spoke-of his-suffering and-the-fire-of YHWH's-word burning within-him.

**17** And-Jeremiah spoke-of his-suffering and-the-fire-of YHWH's-word burning within-him.

**18** Why is-this — from-[the]-womb I-came-out to-see toil and-sorrow, and-my-days are-consumed in-shame?

---
## EMET Literal Notes

- **20:1**: Opening formula for the Jeremiah and Pashhur oracle. Standard prophetic messenger formula with characteristic Jeremianic language.

- **20:9**: Central imagery of the stocks — characteristic of Jeremiah's prophetic rhetoric and covenant lawsuit tradition.

- **20:18**: Concluding declaration — ne'um YHWH ('declares YHWH'). The divine speech formula seals the prophetic oracle.

— EMET
